dish.title: Georgian Adjaruli Khachapuri: Cheese Bread Boats with Egg

recipe_version.title: Georgian Adjaruli Khachapuri: Cheese Bread Boats with Egg
recipe_version.description: Boat-shaped yeasted breads filled with a molten blend of mozzarella and feta, baked until the crust is burnished, then finished with a soft-baked egg in the center and a pat of butter to swirl in at the table. Served with a cucumber, tomato, and dill salad.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: warm, about 105 F, for the dough

steps.title: Make the dough
steps.body: Whisk the flour, yeast, sugar, and 1 1/2 tsp salt in a large bowl. Add 1 cup warm water and 1 tbsp olive oil and knead 8 minutes into a smooth, slightly tacky dough.

steps.title: Rise and preheat
steps.body: Cover and let rise in a warm place 60 minutes, until doubled. After 30 minutes of rising, put a sheet pan on the lower-middle rack and turn the oven on to 475 F to preheat. Meanwhile mix the mozzarella and feta in a medium bowl.

steps.title: Shape the boats
steps.body: Divide the dough into 4 pieces. On parchment, roll each into a 10 x 7-inch oval. Roll the long edges inward toward the center to form raised sides and pinch and twist the ends into points to make a boat. Fill each with a quarter of the cheese.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Slide the parchment onto the hot sheet pan and bake in the preheated 475 F oven until the crust is golden and the cheese bubbles, 14 to 15 minutes.

steps.title: Make the salad
steps.body: While the breads bake, toss the cucumbers, tomatoes, red onion, and dill with 2 tbsp olive oil and 1/4 tsp salt. Runs inside step 4 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Add the eggs
steps.body: Make a well in each boat's cheese with a spoon, crack an egg into each well, and bake 3 to 4 minutes more, until the white is just set and the yolk still runny.

steps.title: Butter and serve
steps.body: Set a pat of butter beside each egg and serve at once with the salad; at the table, swirl the egg and butter into the hot cheese and tear off the crust to dip.

components.name: cheese filling with egg and butter
